To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the mineral composition of Solonetzes is diverse in the West Siberian and East European plains, and the eluvial and illuvial horizons of these soils have different mineral composition, depending on the type and properties of the parent materials and the soil forming conditions.
the eluvial and illuvial distribution patterns of clay minerals (ILSEL < ILBSN > ILBC; SMSEL < SMBSN > SMBC) were found to be the most frequent in Solonetzes.
the eluvial –illuvial distribution (ILSEL < ILSMN > ILBC) of illites is the most frequent variant of the mineralogical distribution in the Solonetz profile.

a quantitative assessment of the mineralogical diversity of Solonetzes, and it is shown that the eluvial distribution of clay minerals is typical of Solonetze soils in the West Siberian Plain, while the eluvial-illuvial distribution is typical of Solonetz soils in the East European Plain.

the mineralogical diversity of the Solonetz soils is much higher than previously thought.

the most frequent type of clay mineral distribution in Solonetzes was eluvial– illuvial (ILSEL < SMSEL < ILBSNL < SMBSN < ILBC < SMBC) in 50–60% of the total number of profiles.

the mineralogical diversity of Solonetzes is determined by the diversity of their parent materials.
the eluvial distribution of clay minerals is typical of Solonetze soils, while their illuvial distribution is not typical.
